reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) without approaching the pad. This revision makes both bonuses one-shot event-gated (can only be collected once per episode) and adds a progress bonus for reducing distance to pad to incentivize approach. The progress bonus is a per-step improvement bonus that rewards getting closer to the pad, which provides a clear gradient for the approach phase.
preserved_design: progress_shaping (distance and angle penalties) with same scales
velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
changed_design: Make controlled_descent_bonus one-shot: use a self attribute (self._controlled_descent_collected) to track if it has been collected this episode. Reset at the start of each episode via hasattr check.

Make touchdown_stability_bonus one-shot: use a self attribute (self._touchdown_stability_collected) to track if it has been collected this episode. Reset at the start of each episode via hasattr check.

Add progress_bonus: +0.1 * (previous_distance - current_distance) if distance decreased, else 0. This provides a per-step incentive to move closer to the pad. Use self._prev_distance to track previous distance, reset at episode start.
Remove the repeatable nature of controlled_descent_bonus and touchdown_stability_bonus to prevent farming.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: instead, we make existing bonuses one-shot and add a progress bonus.
Do not only reduce distance shaping: we add a progress bonus that directly incentivizes approach.
Do not keep repeatable positive terms without success: we make them one-shot.
action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The progress bonus will encourage more use of orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): progress_bonus provides a clear gradient to move toward the pad. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (one-shot) rewards using main engine when near pad and upright. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (one-shot) rewards low velocity at contact. Success bonus provides final sparse signal.
payment_mode_plan: controlled_descent_bonus is one-shot event-gated (collect once per episode). touchdown_stability_bonus is one-shot event-gated (collect once per episode). progress_bonus is per-step but based on improvement (delta), not raw state, so it cannot be farmed indefinitely. objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.
